scope: Bootstrap/launcher/systemd permissions, quoting, environment isolation and guest credential boundaries (src/providers/freestyle.ts, src/providers/opencode.ts, src/safety.ts, src/config.ts, src/settings/*, src/cli.ts, src/cli/arguments.ts, src/serve.ts, src/serve-command.ts, src/main.ts, src/store.ts, src/runtime.ts, permissions/quoting parts of scripts/build.ts, scripts/package.ts, scripts/smoke.ts, .github/workflows/release.yml). Never read real credentials or secret files.

findings.title: Event log file mode is never re-asserted, so a pre-existing loose-mode log keeps its permissions and keeps receiving worker prompts
findings.evidence: appendFileSync(path, `${line}\n`, { mode: 0o600 }) is the only mode control on the append path. Node/Bun apply appendFileSync's `mode` through open(...,'a',mode), which only takes effect on creation, and there is no chmod on this path. renameSync(path, `${path}.1`) at src/runtime.ts:207 preserves the same mode onto the rotated backup. The sibling database does re-assert: src/store.ts:21 calls chmodSync(path, 0o600) unconditionally on every construction. Reached from src/serve.ts:192 via eventLogger(coordinator, `${config.SWARMFORGE_DB_PATH}.log`). Appended lines carry event payloads, which include worker prompts.
findings.reproduction: Reproduced locally with Bun 1.4.2 against the target checkout using a local probe (/tmp/sfrev/probe/p6.ts, exit 0): create a Store, record an event whose data contains a prompt marker, pre-create <DB>.log at 0644 to model a backup restore, drive eventLogger three times, then print modes. Output: swarmforge.sqlite-shm 0600, swarmforge.sqlite 0600, swarmforge.sqlite-wal 0600, swarmforge.sqlite.log 0644, and db 0600 after a second Store(). Trigger in practice: an operator restores/copies the database directory from a backup, or points SWARMFORGE_DB_PATH at a file in a directory they manage by hand.
findings.recommendation: Mirror the database pattern in eventLogger: chmod the log to 0o600 when it exists before/after the first append, and apply the same to the rotated ${path}.1 after renameSync. This removes the asymmetry with src/store.ts:21.
findings.impact: Bounded in the default layout because src/store.ts:19 creates the parent directory 0700, which prevents other local users traversing into it. Becomes real when SWARMFORGE_DB_PATH is placed in a directory that is not 0700 (e.g. a 0755 home directory or an operator-managed /var/lib path): the database is 0600 while the adjacent log holding the same prompts is world-readable. Prompts are credential-free by design, so this is a permissions/consistency defect, not a credential leak.

reviewed_not_defects: SQLite sidecar permissions: src/store.ts:19-22 creates the parent 0700 and chmods the DB 0600 before PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL; verified with a real Store under umask 0022 that DB, -wal and -shm all end at 0600 and the directory at 0700.

Guest credential boundary holds: drove the real FreestyleProvider.prepare() against a capturing local fake client; distinctive non-credential canaries for FREESTYLE_API_TOKEN and SWARMFORGE_API_TOKEN appeared nowhere in the generated guest files or exec commands. workerEnvironment (src/config.ts:170-183) passes only worker/team/task ids, git tree, workspace, the model key and the port.

Guest secrets kept out of systemd introspection: the generated unit has no Environment= lines and no secrets; credentials live in /opt/swarmforge/start.sh at 0700 inside a chmod 700 /opt/swarmforge, so systemctl cat/show do not expose them. The unit is written without an explicit mode, but pinned freestyle@0.2.13 defaults WriteFileOptions.mode to the target's existing mode or 0600 and systemd reads the unit as root.

Quoting: quote() (src/providers/freestyle.ts:8) is correct POSIX single-quote escaping. A hostile SWARMFORGE_GIT_AUTHOR_NAME containing a quote and a command attempt stayed quoted in every generated command and export line. branchFor (src/git-handoff.ts:12-14) strips non-[A-Za-z0-9_-] and idSchema restricts team_id/task_id.

Temporary Git credential lifecycle: withGitAuth (src/providers/freestyle.ts:186-242) writes the token/key 0600 into a 0700 dir, runs the action, rm -f both paths, and raises if the cleanup cannot be confirmed; the original failure is rethrown only after the cleanup attempt.

Guest firewall direction: { source: {}, destination: { public: true } } is an egress allow per the pinned SDK's own semantics; guest ingress is constrained by the tls.rules entry mapping only <worker-slug>.<suffix> to OPENCODE_PORT.
Guest OpenCode server password: src/store.ts:96 generates randomUUID()+randomUUID() (72 hex chars) per worker.

Configuration redaction boundary holds under indirection: with a real config.toml + secrets.env fixture whose credential appeared both as a *_TOKEN line and under a non-resolved key name, redactedSettings and redactedText redacted all canaries in values and free text; collectSecrets runs before parsing so a malformed file cannot echo a value.

Launcher environment isolation: the compiled binary sets autoloadDotenv/Bunfig/Tsconfig/PackageJson false (scripts/build.ts:46-56) and .github/workflows/release.yml:78-81 exercises it under env -i; SWARMFORGE_CONFIG is read only from overrides and the process environment, never an env file.
CI does not interpolate untrusted text into shell: RELEASE_TAG and github.ref_name are passed as quoted argv; no credential appears in a tag, asset name or release note.

Guest mkdir -p without an explicit mode for ${workspace}/.swarmforge/{artifacts,logs} is noted but crosses no boundary: a guest VM has a single principal (the root OpenCode agent) and artifacts are read back through the provider API.

tests.command: Bun 1.4.2 (official, unpacked to /tmp/bun142 because the sandbox bun is 1.3.14 and cannot read this lockfileVersion2 lockfile; lockfile never rewritten). `bun test tests/settings.test.ts tests/inspect.test.ts tests/commands.test.ts` -> exit 0, 76 pass / 0 fail / 646 expect() across 3 files. `bun test tests/serve.test.ts tests/adapters.test.ts tests/safety.test.ts tests/lifecycle.test.ts tests/process-lock.test.ts` -> exit 0, 66 pass / 0 fail / 261 expect() across 5 files. Local probes: /tmp/sfrev/probe/p1.ts (Store on-disk modes) exit 0; p2.ts (prepare() with fake client, credential canaries + hostile author name) exit 0; p3.ts (config/env-file redaction with indirect credential) exit 0; p6.ts (event log mode) exit 0, reproduced the finding.
tests.not_run: Full suite (whole-suite reviewer scope); binary compilation (packaging scope); SWARMFORGE_RUN_SMOKE smoke test (real billable infrastructure, forbidden here).

limitations: Static reading plus local fakes only. No guest VM, no real Freestyle control plane, no in-guest systemd, no real model provider, so runtime-only behaviour of vm.fs.writeTextFile mode handling and of systemctl inside a real guest is unverified. The guest-side runtime view (what the OpenCode agent can actually read) was not observed; conclusions are inferred from the generated start.sh, unit and opencode config. Reviewer experiments live outside the source checkout at /tmp/sfrev/tgt (detached target clone), /tmp/sfrev/probe (probes and fixture), /tmp/sfrev/dbg (throwaway instrumented copy used only to debug my own mistyped fixture key, not a conclusion source) and /tmp/bun142 (Bun 1.4.2). /workspace/repo was left unchanged and clean on the assigned branch at baseline 5672ead2a526e07fea9ed11e58b3725e42013527. All credential-shaped strings here are synthetic local canaries; no real credential, token, key or URL was read and no secret file was inspected.
